PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

South African fashion designer, creative director, educator and business owner with over 20 years of experience in fashion design, garment production, education and business management. Practical experience covers brief analysis, collection development, fabric sourcing, pattern making, cutting, industrial sewing, garment costing, production planning, quality control and product presentation.

Transferable strengths include staff supervision, customer service, negotiation, sales, marketing, branding, project coordination, problem solving, time management, professionalism and working under pressure. These capabilities support opportunities in fashion, production, operations, customer service, training and team supervision.

AI learning is self-taught and began in 2023. Innovative AI Design brings this learning into fashion concepts, image and video workflows, and brand storytelling.
